name: Pimi Admin Agent
author: Himanshu Bhuyan

sections.description:
Pimi Admin Agent puts an assistant in the bottom-right corner of wp-admin. The panel is orange, it is open when the page loads, and the bubble stays there if you close it.

Type a normal sentence and press Send. The assistant carries out the request with WP-CLI and replies in the chat.

Three kinds of changes always stop for your approval:

  • Settings. The chat shows the current value and the new value, then waits for Apply or Cancel.
  • Plugin installs. The chat loads the WordPress.org listing first: name, short description, version, author, WordPress and PHP requirements, active installs, and rating. Nothing is downloaded until you press Install. If that plugin is already installed and active, the chat says so. If it is installed but inactive, the button says Activate.
  • Uninstalls. The chat checks whether the plugin or theme is in use and shows that warning above the question. Press Uninstall to remove it, or Keep it to leave it. WordPress will not remove the active theme or its parent theme, and the chat explains that instead of offering Uninstall.

Administrators always have the chat. In Pimi Agent → Settings they can assign other users. Assigned users get the same assistant on every admin screen. They do not get the Dashboard, Settings, History, or Approvals screens.

Plugin, theme, and WordPress updates run as soon as you send them. A risky bulk delete, such as “Delete all posts”, goes to the approval queue. Another administrator has to approve it. You cannot approve your own request.

If the chat saves you a few clicks, buy me a beer.

What you can ask

Settings

  • Change the site title to My New Site
  • Set the tagline to Just another WordPress site
  • Turn off search engine visibility

Content

  • Create a page called About Us
  • Create a post called Welcome with the content This is my first post
  • Delete the page called About Us
  • Add the About Us page to the Main Menu

Plugins and themes

  • Install Elementor
  • Activate Contact Form 7
  • Deactivate Contact Form 7
  • Update the Contact Form 7 plugin
  • Update all plugins
  • Update WordPress
  • Update the Twenty Twenty-Five theme
  • Update all themes
  • Uninstall the Contact Form 7 plugin

Users, media, and menus

  • Create a user named Pat with email pat@example.com password secret role editor
  • List plugins
  • Upload image https://example.com/photo.jpg
  • Create a menu called Main Menu

Square brackets still work, but they are optional. “Install plugin [Elementor]” and “Install Elementor” do the same thing.

What this plugin does not do

  • Change the site URL or the home URL
  • Edit wp-config.php
  • Run database, shell, or eval commands
  • Uninstall the theme that is live, or the parent of that theme
  • Let someone who is not an administrator create an administrator, or set the default role to administrator
  • Let you approve a queued request that you submitted
  • Install a plugin that WordPress.org does not list
sections.installation:
WP-CLI must be installed on the server. The plugin looks for wp on its own. If the binary lives somewhere else, set the path under Pimi Agent → Settings.

From the Plugins screen

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Pimi Admin Agent”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

From a ZIP file

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  3. Click Activate.

After activation, open any admin screen. The orange chat is already open in the bottom-right corner.
sections.faq:
Where is the assistant?

It is the orange panel at the bottom-right of every wp-admin screen. There is no Assistant item in the menu. Administrators use Pimi Agent for the dashboard, settings, history, and the approval queue.

Why did nothing install when I said “Install Elementor”?

The chat shows Elementor’s WordPress.org details first and waits. Press Install to download and activate it. Press Cancel to leave the site unchanged.

Can editors use the chat?

Only if an administrator assigns them under Pimi Agent → Settings → Chat access. Administrators can always use it.

What needs a second administrator?

Bulk deletes, such as deleting every post or every page. Updates do not. The person who asked for the delete cannot approve it.

Does deactivating the plugin delete my site content?

No. Deactivating Pimi Admin Agent does not remove pages, plugins, or themes you changed with the chat. Data created by this plugin is removed only if you uninstall it and you chose to delete that data.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Replace the assistant page with an orange floating chat on every admin screen
  • Understand plain English, and wait for confirmation before settings, installs, and uninstalls
  • Show the WordPress.org listing before a plugin is installed
  • Warn when a plugin or theme is in use before it is uninstalled
  • Update plugins, themes, and WordPress from the chat
  • Let administrators assign other users to the chat
  • Run chat actions through WP-CLI
  • Keep the approval queue for risky bulk deletes
  • Remove workflows, templates, bulk jobs, and CSV import

2.0.2

  • Escape assistant, bulk-job, and CSV import output
  • Enforce approval and permission checks on every command path
  • Redact passwords in history and exports, and lock down settings import
  • Store CSV files outside the public uploads directory
  • Require exact plugin matches and block private image URLs
  • Fix IP blocking, CSV formula export, the settings capability check, and uninstall cleanup

2.0.0

  • Initial public release
  • Command interface for pages, posts, users, settings, media, menus, and widgets
  • Elementor page commands
  • Plugin install and update
  • Approval queue for high-risk commands
  • Command history and dashboard
